pins.strappingNotes: GPIO 0/2/5/12/15 are strapping pins sampled at reset. They work for sensors/actuators, but avoid pulling them to fixed levels at boot (e.g. avoid strapping-dependent wiring); GPIO 0 must be HIGH at boot, GPIO 2 must be floating or LOW, GPIO 12 must be LOW for correct flash voltage.
GPIO 2/8/9 are strapping pins. GPIO 8 must be HIGH (or floating) at boot; GPIO 9 must be HIGH for normal boot (LOW enters download mode). GPIO 18/19 are USB D-/D+ on native-USB boards.
GPIO 8/9 are strapping pins (ROM message print / boot mode). GPIO 15 is used for the 32.768 kHz crystal on some modules — avoid it when the crystal is populated.

GPIO 0/3/45/46 are strapping pins (boot mode, flash voltage, ROM messages). GPIO 19/20 are USB D-/D+ on native-USB boards; GPIO 26-32 connect to SPI flash and GPIO 33-37 to octal flash/PSRAM on most modules.
